solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Frisky dance with good form

indicators.note: frisky means lively and playful, so the letters of the words that follow are jumbled up

explanation.surface: A lively dance done with good form, as a dance teacher might praise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frisky' is the anagram signal: DANCE and GOOD together give the nine letters to rearrange. 'Form' looks like style or technique but is a shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A twelve-sided polygon is a geometric shape, and a shape can be called a form.

clue.text: Policeman with month to retire took gamble

parts.note: a DI is a Detective Inspector, a British police rank

indicators.note: to retire is to go back, so the abbreviation for the month is read backwards

parts.note: Dec is the short form of December

explanation.surface: A police officer, a month before retirement, has a flutter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to retire' reverses the month; in Britain a DI is a Detective Inspector.
explanation.definitionFit: To dice is to play at dice, so to gamble; the past tense matches 'took gamble'.

clue.text: Enamoured with characters changing conduct

indicators.note: the characters, or letters, of the word before change places, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone smitten finds their behaviour altered by love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters changing' tells you to rearrange the letters of ENAMOURED.
explanation.definitionFit: Demeanour is the way a person behaves or carries themselves, which is their conduct.

clue.text: Finishes copper layers, first article removed

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: removed says the article is taken out of the word for layers; 'first' says it is the first of its two such letters

parts.note: laminates are thin layers bonded together
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone completes a job laying copper sheets after removing an item.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for layers holds two of the article's letter; 'first ... removed' takes out only the earlier one.
explanation.definitionFit: To culminate is to reach a final point or climax, so it ends or finishes.

clue.text: Envies good sport, regularly given daggers

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a sport

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of daggers, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Someone envies a good sport who keeps being given hostile looks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th letters of daggers: D, G, E, S.
explanation.definitionFit: To grudge someone something is to resent their having it, which is close to envying them.

clue.text: With husband in heart, indicating love

indicators.note: in heart puts the husband's letter right in the middle of the word for indicating

parts.note: noting can mean pointing out or indicating

explanation.surface: With her husband at heart, she shows her love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in heart' places the letter at the exact centre of the six-letter word. In tennis scoring 'love' means zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is the tennis score of zero, and zero amounts to nought.

clue.text: Hit hard in belly with power

indicators.note: in puts the letter for hard inside the word for belly

parts.note: tum is a colloquial word for the stomach or belly
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: A boxer lands a powerful punch to the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: To thump is to strike heavily, which is to hit.

clue.text: Very little money end of January

parts.note: tin is old slang for money

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of January

explanation.surface: Cash runs low by the end of January, after Christmas spending.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tiny is extremely small, so very little.

clue.text: Vessel carrying sailor from south of city

indicators.note: carrying means the vessel holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: an urn is a vessel or vase

indicators.note: in a down clue, read from the south means bottom to top, so the sailor's letters are backwards

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a sailor

explanation.surface: A ship carrying a seaman up from the south of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from south' works because this is a down entry: the sailor is read upwards, then 'carrying' puts him in the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Urban is an adjective describing things belonging to a town or city.

clue.text: Publicity meeting journalist stopped

parts.note: PR is public relations, or publicity
an event can be a meeting, as at a racecourse
ed, short for editor, is the usual crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A press call with a reporter is called off.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevent something is to keep it from happening, so prevented means stopped.

clue.text: River the Parisian recalled is brown shade

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the French article is read backwards

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A painter recalls the river near Paris in a brown tint.
explanation.definitionFit: Camel is the light yellowish-brown colour of the animal's coat, a shade of brown.

clue.text: Rocky powerless boxing figure

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the word for powerless goes around the figure

parts.note: unable means without the power to do something
ten is a number, a figure

explanation.surface: Rocky, the film boxer, is a weak fighter here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rocky' and 'boxing' call up the Stallone film boxer, but Rocky is the definition, meaning shaky.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocky argument or position is unstable and hard to defend, which is what untenable means.

clue.text: Pulling leg that one's applied to the board

definitions.text: that one's applied to the board

parts.note: drawing means pulling, as a horse draws a cart
pin is informal for a leg

explanation.surface: Pulling someone's leg, the joker is reported to the board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulling leg' looks like teasing; it is two separate synonyms. A drawing pin is the British term for a thumbtack.
explanation.definitionFit: A thumbtack is pressed into a noticeboard to hold up papers, so it is applied to the board.

clue.text: Insect close to vegetable stake

parts.note: an ant is an insect

indicators.note: close to means the end of, so the final letter of vegetable

explanation.surface: An insect beside a vegetable patch near a garden stake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stake' looks like a garden post but means a bet.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker the ante is the stake each player puts in before the deal.

clue.text: Narrow escape as Charlie evades bear

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to lose a pursuer is to evade them
to bear something, such as a child, is to have it

explanation.surface: Charlie has a narrow escape when he evades a bear.
explanation.definitionFit: A close shave is an idiom for a near miss, a lucky escape from danger.

clue.text: Fraud is a mob's source of power

indicators.note: a fraud is something fake, so the letters that follow are not what they seem and get rearranged

explanation.surface: Organised crime funds its power through fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fraud' is the anagram signal: rearrange the letters of IS A MOB'S.
explanation.definitionFit: Biomass is plant or animal material burnt as fuel to generate energy.

clue.text: Intended resolving other debt

indicators.note: resolving means breaking down into parts and settling anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone planned to settle another outstanding debt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intended' looks like a verb, but here it is the noun: one's fiancé or fiancée.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's intended is the person they are engaged to marry, their fiancé or fiancée.

clue.text: Daring US girl inclined to ignore English

parts.note: gal is an American colloquial word for a girl

indicators.note: to ignore means leaving the letter for English out of the word for inclined

parts.note: leant means inclined, as in leaning over

explanation.surface: A bold American girl is inclined to overlook the English.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallant means brave or heroic, so daring.

clue.text: Accessory a writer finally used, filling part of book

indicators.note: filling means going inside, so the writer and the letter go into the part of the book

parts.note: a page is part of a book
a pen is a writing instrument, a writer

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of used

explanation.surface: A writer's last-used accessory fills part of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' takes the end of 'used'; 'filling' places the writer and that letter after the first letter of the part of book, with the lone 'a' in front.
explanation.definitionFit: An appendage is an extra part attached to something, which is an accessory.

clue.text: Rush to let out grasping Republican

indicators.note: grasping means holding inside, so the R goes inside the phrase for letting out

parts.note: to rent is to let out a property

explanation.surface: A landlord hurries to let a property to a greedy Republican.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grasping' has the two words together hold the Republican at their join.
explanation.definitionFit: A torrent is a violent rush of water, and figuratively any sudden outpouring.

clue.text: Moment leads to pain and sore muscles

parts.note: a trice is an instant, a moment

indicators.note: leads means the first letters, here of pain and sore

explanation.surface: In a moment, exercise brings pain and sore muscles.
explanation.definitionFit: The triceps is a muscle at the back of the upper arm; the word is both singular and plural.

clue.text: Weak inside of mind, depression is back

indicators.note: inside of means the middle letters of mind, without its ends
back means the word for depression and is are read backwards together

parts.note: a dip is a hollow or depression in the ground

explanation.surface: A feeble mind, as depression returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside of' takes the middle two letters of mind; 'back' turns both following words round together.
explanation.definitionFit: Insipid means lacking flavour or vigour, so feeble or weak.

clue.text: Suitable having systematic arrangement

definitions.meaning: proper, in keeping with the rules, as a point of order may be

explanation.surface: Something tidy and well arranged is also appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both permissible under procedure and correctly sorted or arranged.

clue.text: Just functioning, lady disheartened

parts.note: on means working, functioning, as a machine is on

indicators.note: disheartened means losing the heart, so the middle letters of lady go and its two outer letters are kept

explanation.surface: A woman barely coping, feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Only and just are synonyms meaning merely or no more than.

clue.text: Primate gripping bird between both hands

indicators.note: between puts the bird's letters inside the pair of letters for the hands; gripping supports the picture

parts.note: left and right hands, L and R
an emu is a large flightless bird

explanation.surface: A monkey-like animal clutches a bird in both hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemur is a tree-dwelling primate from Madagascar.

clue.text: Cars learner smashed — not totally minor issue

parts.note: L is a learner driver, as on L-plates

indicators.note: smashed means broken up, so the pieces are rearranged
not totally means a letter is lost from minor, its last one

explanation.surface: A learner driver crashes cars over a trivial matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not totally' drops the last letter of minor; 'smashed' then rearranges what is left of it with ISSUE, behind the learner's L.
explanation.definitionFit: Limousines are large luxurious cars, often chauffeur-driven.

clue.text: Despatches object aboard ship

indicators.note: aboard means on board, so the object goes inside the ship's letters

parts.note: SS is steamship
an end is an aim or object

explanation.surface: Messages concern an item carried on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Despatches' looks like a noun, as in military reports, but here it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To despatch something is to send it off, so despatches means sends.

clue.text: Area reserved is dusty

parts.note: shy means reserved or retiring

explanation.surface: A reserved part of a building is left dusty.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashy means covered in or like ashes, grey and powdery, so dusty.

clue.text: Grey matter around domed stripped stone property

indicators.note: around means the word for grey matter encloses the other pieces

parts.note: grey matter is the brain, the head

indicators.note: stripped means the outer letters of domed are removed

parts.note: st is the abbreviation for stone, the weight

explanation.surface: A scientist studies brains, domed heads and stone around a property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped' takes the outer letters off domed; 'around' wraps the grey matter round that and the stone.
explanation.definitionFit: A homestead is a house with its land and buildings, a piece of property.

clue.text: Foreign commander inches over

parts.note: an aga is an Ottoman military commander
in is the abbreviation for inches

explanation.surface: A foreign general moves forward a few inches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is the definition, as in 'do it over'.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something over is to do it once more, a repeat.

clue.text: German's the next to race

parts.note: der is a German word for the
by means beside, next to

explanation.surface: A German says he is next in line to race.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derby is the famous English flat horse race at Epsom.

clue.text: Witch turned back posse recrossing bridges

indicators.note: turned back means the letters spanning the two words are read backwards
bridges means spans across, so the letters are found running across the two words

explanation.surface: A witch drives off a band of pursuers who come back over bridges.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'posse recrossing' backwards from the S of recrossing to the S of posse.
explanation.definitionFit: A sorceress is a woman who practises magic, a witch.
